messages:
sre-oncall: FYI: Saturday 2026-05-16 03:00-05:00 UTC we'll run a controlled reshuffle in us-west-1 to validate graceful drain, autoscaler response, and cold-start mitigation. Expect brief p99 latency blips on some routes. Runbook (view-only): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reshuffle-2026
jamie: Are Dedicated pools impacted?
sre-oncall: No, only shared-hosted pools by default. DM to opt-out dedicated services.
emily: What's the canary plan and rollback?
sre-oncall: Canary: non-prod -> 5% prod -> 20% prod if healthy. Rollback: cancel job & revert routing (commands in runbook). I'll post job IDs before start.
anish: Suggest throttling p99 pager to avoid noisy alerts.
tolga: I'll create a temporary suppression for p99 paging and extend burn-rate window to 6h. Error-rate pager remains active.
infra-bot: Notifications scheduled at 02:30 UTC; synthetic tests at 02:45 UTC.
jamie: Can we pre-warm KV prefixes again?
sre-oncall: Yes, KV warmup 02:40-02:55 per AZ. Command: scripts/warm_kv_prefixes --env prod --region us-west-1
emily: Who owns the postmortem if we get a regression?
sre-oncall: Ops lead @tolga will own PM; aim for draft in 24h. Please loop in SMEs.
anish: I'll monitor canary dashboards.
jamie: :thumbsup: pausing non-essential deploys for affected services.
sre-oncall: Opt-outs via DM before Friday 18:00 UTC. Final reminder Friday 20:00 UTC with job IDs.
